text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good. That's a nice time. My accuracy
has
improved a great deal too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think it's about time for a break.
Whether it's
talking or running, we have
to make sure we have
enough energy for
it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? This is the cafeteria, isn't it? Why does it look so different?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh!
choice_data_list: もしかして、クリスマス用？

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That's right. I didn't even realize it
was that
time of year already!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they're serving roast chicken
and
seasonal cake. Ooh! Look, they have
pizza over
there too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't see any curry, but I suppose that
makes
sense, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Um, I know it's not exactly a traditional
dish for
this time of year...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But at my house, we always used to
make what
everyone liked for our
holiday dinner.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd ask my mom to make a fruitcake for
me, and
Brian would ask me to make
curry for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, she'd always ask at the last
minute, but
the thing is, it takes hours to
stew the vegetables
for her favorite kind
of curry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, the Arima Kinen
falls on a
rather special holiday this year.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh...
choice_data_list: クリスマス当日は妹に何をあげたい？
choice_data_list_en: What do you want to give your little sister for Christmas?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Well, let's see... I suppose I'll give
her the
best race ever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to face her in the Twinkle Series
and run
against her in perfect form.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And I'll prevail with my winning
equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. I have my pride to
preserve as her
older sister.
choice_data_list: 勝利は譲らないんだな
choice_data_list_en: You're not about to give up the win, huh.
You're not about to give up the win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
By the way... what are your favorite
foods?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the most of today and eat
our
favorites!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I have a wonderfully
cheerful
meal together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's so much snow all around. It
really makes
for the perfect festive
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're right. I fit right in, don't I?
choice_data_list: 君の格好もサンタっぽい
貴方の格好もサンタっぽい
choice_data_list_en: Your outfit looks pretty Santa-like, too.
Your outfit looks pretty Santa-like, too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, tell Santa what you
wish for
this year. I might just bring it to
you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Very well. You'll get your wish soon
enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She smiles confidently at me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I have a wonderfully
cheerful
meal together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So... Why did you bring me here again?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: フルーツケーキも食べたいかなって
choice_data_list_en: I kind of wanted to eat fruitcake too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You should think about yourself once in
a while
too. You're far too indulgent
with me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's get two cakes and take them home.
One for
me, and one for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I each get a cake
and enjoy
them together.
